page_note: Page is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate: a continuous teaching about the Wheel, the firmaments, the Living Spirit/Father of Life establishing the heavens, the Third Ambassador, and the fall of the Hyle into three kinds. Two dialogue frame interpolations (seg 4 introducing disciples' question; seg 15 introducing Mani's reply, with seam flag). The disciples' question (segs 5-14) is itself substantive Persian-style cosmological inquiry — the question structure reveals the teaching topic, so its content belongs to the substrate. Editorial fatigue score is negative (substrate density rises in second half), confirming the second half is pure cosmological narrative.
